arguments.old_string:
**Purpose:** Bridges an opencode rate-limit window with freebuff: announces when opencode resumes (clock time), ensures freebuff is ready (DeepSeek V4 Pro, standard mode), then — when tmux is available — drives freebuff autonomously: if ralph/tasks.md does not exist yet or is empty (rate limit hit during planning) it first has freebuff create the plan via `run_freebuff_planning`, then works tasks via `run_freebuff_until` when incomplete tasks exist; without tmux it hands the terminal to the interactive freebuff session instead. Afterwards sleeps whatever remains of the window (skipped only when every task is checked, per `unfinished_work_remains`) and returns so the loop switches back to opencode (the faster of the two).

**Parameters:**
- `goal: str` — the user's overall goal, passed through to freebuff task prompts. Non-empty.
- `wait_seconds: int` — the rate-limit wait from run_opencode (header retry-after or the 20 h default). Positive.

**Returns:** `None`, only after the full window has elapsed (or all tasks completed).

**Side effects:** Prints handoff status (flushed); everything `ensure_freebuff` and `run_freebuff_until` do; may run the blocking interactive freebuff session; sleeps the remaining window.

**Raises:** Nothing beyond what `ensure_freebuff` raises.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `plan_tasks`, `ralph_loop`, `replan_tasks`, and `verify_task` when run_opencode reports a rate limit. Calls `ensure_freebuff`, `run_freebuff_planning`, `run_freebuff_until`, `unfinished_work_remains`, `count_total_tasks`, `count_incomplete_tasks`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-09 — strengthened checks to ensure planning is triggered when tasks.md is stale or empty.
arguments.new_string:
**Purpose:** Bridges the window when every CLI agent (claude when enabled, opencode) is rate limited by running freebuff: announces when the earliest limit clears (clock time), ensures freebuff is ready (DeepSeek V4 Pro, standard mode), then — when tmux is available — drives freebuff autonomously: if ralph/tasks.md does not exist yet or is empty (rate limit hit during planning) it first has freebuff create the plan via `run_freebuff_planning`, then works tasks via `run_freebuff_until` when incomplete tasks exist; without tmux it hands the terminal to the interactive freebuff session instead. Afterwards sleeps whatever remains of the window (skipped only when every task is checked, per `unfinished_work_remains`) and returns so the loop switches back to the smartest agent `cli_agent` then offers.

**Parameters:**
- `goal: str` — the user's overall goal, passed through to freebuff task prompts. Non-empty.
- `wait_seconds: int` — seconds until the earliest limited agent resets (from `handle_rate_limit`). Non-negative.

**Returns:** `None`, only after the window has elapsed (or all tasks completed).

**Side effects:** Prints handoff status (flushed); everything `ensure_freebuff` and `run_freebuff_until` do; may run the blocking interactive freebuff session; sleeps the remaining window.

**Raises:** Nothing beyond what `ensure_freebuff` raises.

**Callers/Callees:** Called by `handle_rate_limit` when no CLI agent is available. Calls `ensure_freebuff`, `run_freebuff_planning`, `run_freebuff_until`, `unfinished_work_remains`, `count_total_tasks`, `count_incomplete_tasks`, `cli_agent`.

**Last modified:** 2026-06-10 — waits only until the earliest agent reset and resumes the smartest available agent; previously strengthened planning checks.
